Community autosplitter · Windows

TUNG LiveSplit files

Includes only the ASL script, supplied splits and layout, and a launcher that updates file paths for your computer. The Coordinates mod is a separate download.

Download autosplitter ↓Coordinates mod

Requires LiveSplit for Windows, the Scriptable Auto Splitter component, and Wood with Coordinates enabled for the Hedge split.

Install and start

  1. Install LiveSplit and open it once. In Edit Layout, add Control → Scriptable Auto Splitter if it is not already present.
  2. Install Wood Setup, then download the separate Coordinates mod from the official mod collection if it is not already installed.
  3. Extract the autosplitter ZIP to a permanent, writable folder. Do not run it from inside the ZIP.
  4. Double-click Launch-TUNG-LiveSplit.cmd and select your LiveSplit.exe. The launcher connects the script, layout, and splits to their current file locations.
  5. In Scriptable Auto Splitter settings, enable Start, Split, and Reset. Keep Synchronize Game Time with TUNG's speedrun timer enabled.
  6. The supplied timer and split columns use Game Time. Right-click the timer and select Compare Against → Game Time.
  7. In TUNG, use normal Speedrun mode. Disable Tiny Tung and bhop, do not use a checkpoint, let LiveSplit see the main menu, then select New Game.

Included Any% segments

  1. Valves unlocked
  2. Valve 1
  3. Valve 2
  4. Valve 3
  5. Valve 4
  6. Door
  7. Hedge
  8. Finish

Valves may be collected in any order. The Hedge split requires the separate Coordinates mod to export live player coordinates; the autosplitter archive does not contain or install that mod. If an intermediate event is missed, finishing still ends the run and skipped times remain blank. Save the run under your own filename to preserve PBs.

The Hedge trigger uses the supplied grounded-landing capture to define an observed position band. It still needs confirmation in a fresh live run; the trace alone does not establish the full hedge bounds.

Known limitations

The autosplitter accepts only the tested TUNG Steam build and executable hash documented in its included README. Checkpoint loads, Tiny Tung, bhop, and other game builds are unsupported. Game Time follows TUNG's speedrun clock and its pause/loading behavior.

If LiveSplit was already running, open the supplied split file with Open Splits → From File and the layout with Open Layout → From File. If the folder is moved, rerun the launcher to repair its file paths.
